name: Rotting Orchard
summary: The Rotting Orchard is a blighted, abandoned fruit grove situated in southern Duskwood. Once a source of harvest for the nearby settlement of Darkshire, it has fallen into ruin and is now overrun by ravenous lupine predators known as the Nightbane pack.

sections.title: Den of the Nightbane
sections.body: Located east of the ruined Yorgen Farmstead and west of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, the Rotting Orchard stands as a grim testament to Duskwood's decline. The trees hang heavy with withered, spoiled fruit, while dilapidated barns and outbuildings have been converted into rough encampments by the Nightbane worgen. Nightbane Stalkers prowl the twisted brush, while dark casters known as Shadow Weavers weave their sinister magic amid the decaying timber. The pack answers to the fierce worgen Gutspill and Nefaru, who lair in the nearby mine of Roland's Doom.

faq.q: What creatures occupy the Rotting Orchard?
faq.answer: The orchard is completely infested by the Nightbane pack, a faction of ravenous worgen. These include cunning prowlers called Nightbane Stalkers, and dark spellcasters known as Nightbane Shadow Weavers.

faq.q: Where is the Rotting Orchard located in Duskwood?
faq.answer: The Rotting Orchard lies in southern Duskwood, southwest of the town of Darkshire. It is nestled right between the ruined Yorgen Farmstead to its west and the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery to its east.

faq.q: Who leads the worgen in this orchard?
faq.answer: The Nightbane worgen here are led by the brutes Gutspill and Nefaru, who make their lair in the mine of Roland's Doom just east of the orchard.

faq.q: Was this place always overrun by monsters?
faq.answer: No. Like many surrounding homesteads in Duskwood, it was once a productive farm and fruit grove supporting the local human populace before dark curses and supernatural horrors overtook the region and drove the farmers away.

angles.text: The encroachment of the Nightbane worgen at the Rotting Orchard poses a direct predatory threat to the fragile security of Darkshire just up the road.
The twisted trees and ruined outbuildings provide prime stalking ground, but the predatory senses and spellcraft of the Nightbane pack make it an ambush waiting to happen.
